page.layout: One title page: a full-width heading block at the top, two parallel columns of names (left and right) in its middle, then full-width lines below to the imprint. Right margin holds library stamps and an ornament, which are not transcribed.

main_text.l: Jam autem denuò revisæ, correctæ, & Indice Rerum ac Verborum auctæ.
JOH. MORINI, Congreg. Orat. Paris. P.P.

page.notes: Two library stamps (Biblioteca Romana/Roman stamp on the right and a stamp in the lower right) and a crown and oval emblem/stamp on the right are not printed text and are omitted. The ornament near "Cum notis" and the mottled background are not text. Words in the "Præmissa" line and the "enucleatæ" line are partly obscured by the stains; the spelling is read as printed, with the "Pramissa" ligature taken as "Præmissa". "Iam" is written "Jam" under the u/v and i/j rule.
